rows.grounds: compound: mūla-mantra-pratiṣṭhātrī; feminine agent noun denoting one who establishes the root mantra
compound: mūla-mantra-praharṣiṇī; feminine agent noun denoting one who rejoices in the root mantra

items.question: What establishing and rejoicing functions does the goddess perform in relation to the root mantra?
premises: The goddess is described as establishing the root mantra.
The goddess is described as rejoicing in the root mantra.
Both epithets characterize her active relation to the root mantra.
items.inference: The goddess both establishes and delights in the root mantra.
items.plain_english: She who establishes the root mantra, she who rejoices in the root mantra.
